prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return ES module solution.ts.
Required API: export function canonicalPath(base:string, segments:string[]):string|null
Behavior: Join a base absolute slash path and relative path segments. Ignore empty and dot segments, resolve dot-dot without escaping root, collapse repeated slashes, and return null/None/error marker for a non-absolute base or an attempted root escape. The root result is '/'.
Visible example: base /a/b with segments ../c, ./d becomes /a/c/d; base / with .. is rejected.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

Implement the following API.

File contract: Return ES module solution.ts.
Required API: export function canonicalPath(base:string, segments:string[]):string|null
Behavior: Join a base absolute slash path and relative path segments. Ignore empty and dot segments, resolve dot-dot without escaping root, collapse repeated slashes, and return null/None/error marker for a non-absolute base or an attempted root escape. The root result is '/'.
Visible example: base /a/b with segments ../c, ./d becomes /a/c/d; base / with .. is rejected.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: const f:(base:string,segments:string[])=>string|null=(b,s)=>{if(!b.startsWith('/'))return null;const p:string[]=[];for(const r of[b,...s])for(const x of r.split('/')){if(!x||x==='.')continue;if(x==='..'){if(!p.length)return null;p.pop()}else p.push(x)}return'/'+p.join('/')};export{f as canonicalPath};
